title: Who gets the proceeds from Anthropic’s IPO?
description: Anthropic has closed its IPO. The proceeds are split between the company and selling stockholders. Two proposed proofs of the Riemann hypothesis await scrutiny, and Signal explains why it is restricting mobile assistants’ access to chat screens.

anthropic-ipo-closing.verification_scope: Company announcement on the public offering, selling stockholders and concurrent private placement.
